message.content:
An illustration on a red-bordered magazine cover titled "TEMPO" depicts several people inside a train car. In the upper right and center, three headlines read "INVESTIGASI: NARKOBA BARU", "TOKOH SENI 2013", and "TERTEKAN KARENA RUPIAH". Below the main title, "6-12 JANUARI 2014" is printed. 

Two primary figures stand holding white overhead hand straps. On the left, a woman with dark hair and glasses wears a black shirt with a red collar. She faces a man on the right wearing a white button-down shirt. Between them, white text reads "SIMALAKAMA MEGA JOKOWI". Behind them, a row of unoccupied red upholstered seats is visible. Other passengers are scattered around: a seated person with their head down, a person in the foreground wearing large white headphones while looking at a mobile device, and others partially visible at the edges of the frame. The train interior features blue-tinted windows and metallic-looking overhead racks. A barcode, the price "RP 33,000", and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO" appear in the bottom-left corner.
